intro: Discover Tenerife, from sunny south-coast resorts to volcanic landscapes and historic towns. Plan your days and save favourite places, memorable visits and photos privately on your device.

areas.name: Costa Adeje
areas.description: South-west resort area with beaches, coastal walks, restaurants and family-friendly facilities.

areas.name: Playa de las Américas
areas.description: Lively south-coast resort known for beaches, dining and nightlife.

areas.name: Los Cristianos
areas.description: Harbour town with beaches, cafés and ferry connections to other Canary Islands.

areas.name: Puerto de la Cruz
areas.description: North-coast town with historic streets, seafront walks and gardens.

areas.name: Santa Cruz de Tenerife
areas.description: Island capital with shops, museums, markets and urban parks.

areas.name: La Laguna
areas.description: Historic university city with colourful streets and traditional architecture.

areas.name: El Médano
areas.description: Relaxed coastal town popular for windsurfing and kitesurfing; check wind and sea conditions.

attractions.name: Teide National Park
attractions.description: Volcanic landscapes surrounding Mount Teide. Check weather, road access, altitude and any permits before visiting.

attractions.name: Mount Teide cable car
attractions.description: High-altitude cable car experience subject to weather, booking and operating conditions; summit access may require a separate permit.

attractions.name: Anaga Rural Park
attractions.description: Mountain forests, viewpoints and hiking routes in the north-east; check trail restrictions and weather.

attractions.name: Masca village
attractions.description: Mountain village with dramatic scenery and winding access roads; check transport and any trail booking requirements.

attractions.name: Auditorio de Tenerife
attractions.description: Distinctive concert venue in Santa Cruz; check current events and visitor arrangements.

attractions.name: Garachico
attractions.description: Historic coastal town with volcanic shoreline and natural swimming areas; enter the water only when conditions are safe.

beaches.name: Playa del Duque
beaches.description: Popular Costa Adeje beach with nearby promenade and services.

beaches.name: Playa de Fañabé
beaches.description: Sandy beach and busy promenade in Costa Adeje.

beaches.name: Playa de las Vistas
beaches.description: Broad beach between Los Cristianos and Las Américas, with nearby cafés and services.

beaches.name: Playa de Los Cristianos
beaches.description: Harbour-side beach close to shops and restaurants.

beaches.name: Playa de las Teresitas
beaches.description: Golden-sand beach near Santa Cruz; check beach conditions and transport.

beaches.name: Playa Jardín
beaches.description: North-coast black-sand beach in Puerto de la Cruz; check current swimming restrictions and water quality.

beaches.name: Playa de El Médano
beaches.description: Long sandy beach popular for watersports; often windy.

markets.name: Mercado Nuestra Señora de África
markets.description: Well-known covered market in Santa Cruz for produce and local foods; check opening times.

markets.name: Costa Adeje shopping areas
markets.description: Browse shops and cafés around resort centres and promenades.

markets.name: Los Cristianos shopping streets
markets.description: Explore local shops and market options; confirm market days and locations locally.

markets.name: La Laguna historic centre
markets.description: Independent shops and cafés along pedestrian-friendly historic streets.

nightlife.name: Playa de las Américas evenings
nightlife.description: Busy nightlife areas with bars, music and late-night venues; check age restrictions and opening hours.

nightlife.name: Costa Adeje waterfront
nightlife.description: Relaxed bars and restaurants along the coast.

nightlife.name: Los Cristianos harbour area
nightlife.description: Restaurants and evening strolls around the harbour and town.

nightlife.name: Puerto de la Cruz
nightlife.description: Town-centre restaurants, cafés and cultural events; check current listings.

nightlife.name: Live shows and entertainment
nightlife.description: Schedules and tickets change; check official venue information before travelling.

family.name: Siam Park
family.description: Water park in the south; check tickets, seasonal hours and ride restrictions.

family.name: Loro Parque
family.description: Wildlife attraction in Puerto de la Cruz; review visitor information and animal-welfare considerations before visiting.

family.name: Whale and dolphin watching
family.description: Boat excursions depart from south-coast harbours; choose responsible operators and check sea conditions.

family.name: Beach and promenade day
family.description: Choose a beach suited to your group and follow lifeguard flags and sun-safety advice.

family.name: Teide viewpoints
family.description: Family-friendly sightseeing stops where accessible; bring layers because temperatures change with altitude.

dining.name: Costa Adeje seafront
dining.description: Wide choice of cafés and restaurants near the promenade; check menus and prices.

dining.name: Los Cristianos old streets
dining.description: Casual dining and cafés around the town centre and harbour.

dining.name: La Laguna traditional restaurants
dining.description: Explore Canarian dishes in the historic centre.

dining.name: Puerto de la Cruz town centre
dining.description: Restaurants and cafés around the old streets and seafront.

dining.name: Guachinches
dining.description: Traditional local eating spots, especially in northern Tenerife; availability and opening days can vary.

daytrips.name: Teide National Park
daytrips.description: See volcanic scenery and viewpoints; check road conditions, altitude, weather and permits.

daytrips.name: La Laguna and Anaga
daytrips.description: Combine the historic city with mountain scenery if travel conditions allow.

daytrips.name: Garachico and Icod de los Vinos
daytrips.description: Explore a historic coastal town and the famous dragon tree area.

daytrips.name: Masca and Teno mountains
daytrips.description: Scenic mountain route; roads can be narrow and access rules can change.

daytrips.name: Santa Cruz and Las Teresitas
daytrips.description: City sightseeing followed by time near the beach.

daytrips.name: La Gomera
daytrips.description: Ferry day trip from Los Cristianos; check sailing times, costs and weather.

transport.name: TITSA buses
transport.description: Public buses connect many towns and resorts. Check official routes, fares and schedules.

transport.name: Tenerife tram
transport.description: Tram services connect Santa Cruz and La Laguna; check current routes and fares.

transport.name: Tenerife South Airport (TFS)
transport.description: Main airport for many south-coast holidays; compare transfers and bus options.

transport.name: Tenerife North Airport (TFN)
transport.description: Airport near La Laguna serving many inter-island and mainland routes.

transport.name: Car hire and mountain roads
transport.description: Mountain routes may be steep and winding. Check parking, road closures and insurance.

transport.name: Ferries
transport.description: Services connect Tenerife with other Canary Islands; verify departure port and sailing times.

useful.name: Emergency services
useful.description: Call 112 in an emergency in Spain and the Canary Islands.

useful.name: Sun and altitude
useful.description: Use sun protection and take extra care on exposed volcanic trails and at altitude.

useful.name: Travel documents and insurance
useful.description: Check current entry rules, travel insurance and healthcare arrangements before travelling.

useful.name: Time zone
useful.description: Tenerife uses the same clock time as the UK throughout the year.

useful.name: Live information
useful.description: Weather, road closures, attraction availability and transport timetables require an internet connection.
